then.text: Paradise Mill. Brick, windows and clatter. These handlooms were working right up until 1981.
The Jacquard loom reads its pattern from a chain of punched cards. A hole means a thread lifts. It is a computer made of wood.
A weaver on a very fine pattern might finish only a few inches in a day. Silk rewards patience, and punishes sneezing.

else.text: Is that a card from the Silk Museum? Give it here. Oh, that's a lovely pattern. Every hole's a thread lifting. Every gap's a thread staying put.
Tell the curator thanks. And read the blue plaque on the front on your way out. She'll test you. She tests the postman.
